      "text": "\n\n\nYes, this is actually a known and actively tracked bug for **osu!lazer**, and it\u0027s quite different from the 12-year-old thread you found regarding osu!stable. \n\nLooking at your screenshot, the process is using **8.8% CPU**. On a modern multi-core processor, ~8% usually means that exactly **one single CPU core is maxed out at 100% capacity**. This perfectly aligns with the findings from the osu! development team. \n\nHere is the current knowledge around what is causing this, and how you can make dealing with it much less annoying.\n\n### The Probable Cause\nBecause osu!lazer is built to be extremely seamless, it runs a lot of operations asynchronously (in the background) so your menus don\u0027t freeze. \n\nAccording to developers on the official osu! GitHub (specifically under Bug Issues #10067 and #15955), when you close the game, the visual window shuts down instantly. However, if a background thread gets stuck in an **infinite loop**, the process refuses to terminate and stays active in Task Manager. \n\nThe most common triggers for this \"zombie process\" are:\n*   **Stuck Beatmap Conversions:** Calculating star ratings or converting standard maps to other modes (especially Mania) on maps with buggy or zero-length sliders.\n*   **Unfinished Background Tasks:** Exiting the game while a beatmap is importing, downloading, or processing audio. \n*   **Driver Hangs:** An audio or graphics driver failing to release the game gracefully when the window closes.\n\n### Workarounds to Prevent It\n*   **Don\u0027t Alt+F4 from Song Select:** Try to build a habit of backing all the way out to the absolute main menu before hitting exit. This gives background beatmap calculations a moment to safely pause.\n*   **Let it finish thinking:** If you notice the star rating of a map is struggling to load or continuously calculating, do not close the game right then. Switch to a different map to break the loop, and *then* exit.\n\n### The \"Quality of Life\" Fix \nSince you leave your PC on overnight and dealing with Task Manager every time you want to play is incredibly tedious, you can create a **One-Click Kill Switch** on your desktop to instantly wipe the ghost process.\n\n1. Right-click anywhere on your Windows Desktop and select **New \u003e Shortcut**.\n2. In the location box, paste the following exact command:\n   `taskkill /F /IM \"osu!.exe\" /T`\n   *(Note: Depending on your installation, if this doesn\u0027t work, change it to `taskkill /F /IM \"osu-lazer.exe\" /T`)*\n3. Click **Next**, name the shortcut something like \"Kill osu!\", and click **Finish**.\n4. *(Optional)* Right-click the new shortcut, go to **Properties \u003e Shortcut \u003e Advanced**, and check **Run as administrator** to ensure it always works. \n\nNow, whenever you want to play osu! after leaving your PC on, just double-click that shortcut. A quick black command box will flash, the stuck process will be instantly terminated, and you can open your game normally without ever opening Task Manager.\n\n**Long-term:** Since Lazer is heavily in development, the devs are constantly trying to patch out the specific files causing these loops. If you ever feel like helping out, immediately after you have to kill the process, you can grab your `performance.log` and `runtime.log` from `%AppData%/osu/logs` and submit them to the ppy/osu GitHub.",
